findings.description: The public /runtime-config.js file served to every visitor (including signed-out users) contains the customer's username and password in base64 (field a decodes to customer-acbb:[redacted]).
repro: Base64-decode the value of field a: [redacted] gives customer-acbb:[redacted]

findings.description: After 'Reset App State' with an item in the cart, the product list keeps showing 'Remove' on Sauce Labs Bike Light even though the cart badge is cleared and the cart is empty. The stale state only goes away after a reload.
repro: Click Add to cart on Sauce Labs Bike Light
Open the menu and click Reset App State
Observe the Bike Light button still reads Remove and the cart badge is gone
Reload the page and observe the button reads Add to cart

notes: Tested sign-in, inventory listing and sorting (price and name), product detail pages, add to cart and badge, cart contents, checkout totals (tax 8 percent and total checked), order completion, logout, and anonymous access to protected routes (redirect to login works). Not tested in depth: checkout field validation, cart quantity edits, performance timing, accessibility.
